scope: Iced desktop design rounds of 2026-09-10: visual, interaction and idle-cost verification for commits 4f5b921, 17ca37a, 00c1c98, 4f0f579 on codex/desktop-delivery. Source-bound to the release UI binary below. Not a release acceptance report; native workflow acceptance and packaging remain in the delivery reports.

native_workflow_smoke_debug.result: timed out at step 64 of 96 in the first window
native_workflow_smoke_debug.note: debug rendering sits at the 150 s per-window budget; two earlier debug runs of the same day passed at 152 s and 116 s. Release is the acceptance path.

real_pointer_hover.method: A compiled Swift helper reads the window frame with CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo, activates the process, and posts CGEvent mouseMoved to the HID tap while the release window runs in smoke mode on a private fixture daemon; the scenario pauses 5 s and then captures. Pointer position was read back after posting. No accessibility permission was required. Raw captures show local project names and are kept off the repository.

results.outcome: tooltip 'Discovered · no live agents' rendered beside the dot
row hover surface rendered; proves pointer delivery

results.target: session row dot (before tooltips were removed there in 4f0f579)
results.outcome: tooltip rendered; the row's own words were visible beside it, which is why 4f0f579 removes tooltips from rows that print their words

real_pointer_hover.capture_artifact: Captures come from iced's window::screenshot, which re-renders the renderer's last layers; text primitives hold weak paragraph references, so text whose widget state was re-created since the last frame is absent from the image. Opening a tooltip invalidates layout, so in the rail-dot capture the selected session row's texts were re-created immediately before the capture and are missing while its dot and chip render. The same fixture and binary rendered that row fully in the session-row capture, and the codex live look on the real daemon rendered rows normally. External screenshots were not used.

idle_cpu.method: Release window on a private fixture daemon with one registered agent, no pointer input, 30 s and 60 s runs; CPU seconds from os.wait4 rusage; idle percent = (cpu_60s - cpu_30s) / 30. One core = 100. High variance: the window refreshes runtimes every 30 s and redraws on a 2 s tick, so alignment differs between runs.
idle_cpu.note: The first 'dark' sample under current_00c1c98_uncached_icons ran with rejected preferences and is effectively a light run. Caching icon geometry removed the per-frame geometry damage (tiny-skia treats live geometry as always damaged). Within this method's variance the redesigned window is not costlier at idle than the pre-redesign build; the 0.5 percent figure in the 2026-09-09 report used ps pcpu sampling, a different method, and is not comparable.

memory.note: ps RSS medians from the standard smoke: 2026-09-09 release 169.6 MiB; 2026-09-10 release at 00c1c98 188.7 MiB (bundled Inter faces, raster image support, canvas).
